diagnosis.root_cause: At 21.5 s, an external pose reset (/initialpose) set the estimate to (-4.78, -3.4), followed immediately by a jump of 2.66 m and 0.54 rad at 21.7 s. This caused the robot's estimated position to diverge from reality, leading to repeated planner failures (starting at 21.7 s) and eventual mission failure.
